newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Teleport started with hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Teleport started with hold.

text.p: --Chicago Corp said it initiated coverage of Teleport Communications Group Inc with a hold rating.
--"We are bullish on Teleport but price-sensitive to the four-point run-up in the stock on Friday," Chicago Corp said in a report.
--Teleport, a competitive local exchange carrier offering local telecommunications services, should deliver growth of over 50 percent and improved EBITDA margins in 1997-98, Chicago Corp said.
